name: Error Samples
query:
SELECT
	e.creation AS "When:Datetime:160",
	e.name AS "Error Log:Link/Error Log:110",
	LEFT(e.method, 100) AS "Error:Data:360",
	e.owner AS "User:Link/User:200",
	e.reference_doctype AS "On:Data:120",
	e.reference_name AS "Record:Data:120",
	RIGHT(TRIM(e.error), 300) AS "Traceback End:Data:600"
FROM `tabError Log` e FORCE INDEX (creation)
WHERE e.creation >= %(from_date)s AND e.creation < %(to_date)s + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND e.method LIKE %(title)s
ORDER BY e.creation DESC
LIMIT 200
